purpose: Machine-readable feature list for the ECAS harness

features.validation: AGENTS.md answers the fresh-session questions and links to focused topic docs
A new session can read current focus, blocked items, and verification baseline

features.description: Record durable design decisions in DECISIONS.md
features.validation: Important architectural and harness choices are written down outside chat
A fresh checkout can run one initialization command before feature work

features.description: Keep only one task active at a time
features.validation: WIP=1 is enforced in issue pickup, feature list policy, and lifecycle rules

features.description: Drive autonomous work from GitHub Issues
features.validation: `ready-for-agent` issues exist, an `in-progress` claim state exists, and the loop can pick a single issue without duplication

features.description: Prevent premature victory with executable done gates
features.validation: Agents must run static, targeted, and runtime checks before saying done
Each coding task records a sprint contract, verification evidence, risks, and handoff

features.description: Leave a clean state at the end of every session
features.validation: Clean-state checklist covers verification, git status, temporary artifacts, progress, feature state, and PR evidence
